target_definition: Non-adherent if PDC < 0.80 in the 2016 prediction window

nvflare_metrics.source_note: FLARE metrics were provided from the completed simulator run; formal Task 10 validation files were not found.

patient_identifier_policy: Demo patient IDs only (DEMO-XXXXXX format). No TAJ, TAJ_NORM, or real patient identifiers in app-facing files.
privacy_notes: App-facing files contain demo-safe IDs only.
No real patient identifiers are stored in data/app/.
Prediction scores are derived from 2015 observation-window features.
Data was generated in a centralized development environment.
Federated learning reduces raw data movement but does not eliminate all privacy risk.
limitations: This is a claims-based adherence risk signal, not a clinical diagnosis.
PDC is used as a pragmatic proxy for medication adherence.
DOT is used as a days-supply proxy for PDC; requires clinical validation.
The model is not clinically validated and is not deployment-ready.
Predictions are based on historical claims data from 2015.
The C09 cohort covers antihypertensive medications only.
Model convergence warning was recorded during training (max_iter reached).
No secure aggregation or differential privacy was used in FL simulations.
split_reconstruction_note: Test split was recreated deterministically using the same logic as Task 6: train/validation/test = 70/15/15, stratified by label_non_adherent, random_state=42.
